title: Two men in El Paso say they are escaped descendants of humans taken off Earth as slaves

tellings.quote: when the ETSs left the earth they took humans with him as slaves.

plain: Two men in El Paso, Texas, are said to have claimed that they descend from humans whom extraterrestrials took off Earth as slaves long ago, and that they escaped back. Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, tells this on Michels' show, passing on what the UFO journalist Linda Moulton Howe told him. If true, it would mean people have been living off Earth for generations.
